def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys/values on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    Returns the value of mode, then the value of level, then the values of
    any other keys in order of first appearance. If a key repeats, its last
    value wins. keys[i] is set to values[i].
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["level", "x"], values=["5", "y"]) == ["fast", "5", "y"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "mode", "x"], values=["1", "slow", "2"]) == ["slow", "3", "2"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    others: dict[str, str] = {}
    order: list[str] = []
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        v = values[i]
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k in others:
                others[k.copy()] = v.copy()
            else:
                order.append(k.copy())
                others[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    out: list[str] = [mode.copy(), level.copy()]
    for k in order:
        out.append((others.get(k) else "").copy())
    return out
